answer_full.offer: A personal, version-controlled repository for storing customized agent setups—like advisor and decision-maker configurations—so fresh agent sessions can resume project work directly from the repository without depending on a single chat's memory. Includes a sample configuration module with a decision-judging extension, a protocol for tracking work through GitHub issues, and a pattern for keeping API keys secure outside version control.
answer_full.mechanism: Work begins as a GitHub issue that owns task scope and acceptance criteria. Contributors work on a task branch and periodically checkpoint progress (commit + push to an exact revision), receiving a timestamped receipt tied to that commit. Pull requests with review merge into the main branch; only merged work counts as delivered. When merged, setup modules are ready to copy into a user's local agent directory, with environment variable names stored in the repository but actual secret values kept only in local gitignored files.
